answer: Duplicate identities must repeat the full voyage of stake and challenge, so each fake node costs real capital plus attestation fees, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. A concrete sybil defense is stake-bonded identity with slashing: each agent locks a sable-denominated bond before voting, and peers attest only after a raven-signed challenge proves unique liveness. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
